description: SPIKE-ONLY collection for issue #614. Deliberately distinct from the future production NSID dev.rollercoaster.badge.credential (see docs/research/atproto-evaluation.md) so throwaway test records can never be mistaken for real published badges. Reverse-DNS authority: rollercoaster.dev.

main.description: One published badge credential. The PDS stores this verbatim; it is not validated by any AppView because no AppView indexes this collection.

credential.description: Compact VC-JWT (OB3 credential signed ES256). The JWT's `iss` is the credential issuer and may be a did:key that is NOT the repo's own did:plc — that decoupling is the question this spike answers.

issuer.description: Denormalised copy of the JWT `iss` claim so a firehose consumer can filter without decoding the JWT.

note.description: Free text for the spike run (which script wrote it, which question it tests).
